messages:
anna: Quick RFC follow-up: we've seen a surprising number of bugs from clients treating pinned model IDs as immutable. That blocks soft migrations and complicates cache keys. I'm proposing a tighter rollout metadata surface: explicit `lineage`, `provenance`, and an `immutability_level` enum so clients and SDKs can make safe assumptions. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

mike: Strong +1. If we communicate immutability, SDK caches and CDN keys can be correct. Need to decide default behavior though - ops can't break customers.

sasha: can't change default for release channels without opt-in. Customers with compliance needs use hard pins today. Suggest defaults by channel: release->hard, canary/experimental->soft.

dev-jin: Draft schema (non-normative) below. New fields are optional and guarded by schema_version so older clients tolerate them. Use signed rollback_token for authorised rollbacks.

```json
{
  "model_id": "rwd/llama-x-13b@2026-03-01",
  "schema_version": 2,
  "lineage": ["rwd/llama-x-13b@2026-01-15", "rwd/llama-x-13b@2025-11-03"],
  "provenance": "registry://prod/models/rwd/llama-x-13b#build-20260301",
  "immutability_level": "soft", // enum: hard | soft | ephemeral
  "migration_window_seconds": 172800,
  "compat_hints": ["tokenizer:v2", "positional-enc:fixed"],
  "rollback_token": "sig:v1:base64sig..."
}
```

anna: Notes/questions: 1) migration_window_seconds should surface to SDKs and invalidate caches TTLs accordingly; 2) compat_hints should be lightweight strings (avoid deep nested structures to prevent fragility); 3) define semantics: hard = never automatically remap, soft = resolver can remap within migration_window, ephemeral = server-controlled short-lived alias.

mike: Telemetry is important: emit events migration.initiated, migration.completed, migration.rollback with tenant and model tags. That lets us measure churn and set safe defaults. Also need control-plane-signed rollback_token format and verification steps.

sasha: Operational playbook: customers on release channel should get a migration notice email + optional opt-in period. For enterprise/private, we expose an API to convert pin types (hard->soft) with explicit consent.

dev-jin: Backcompat plan: server sets schema_version=2 only when it includes new fields. SDKs must implement graceful-parse: unknown fields ignored, missing fields mean legacy semantics (treat as hard pin). We'll add unit tests that simulate older SDKs hitting v2 metadata.

anna: Action items: jin -> update RFC with schema snippet + parsing guidelines; mike -> add telemetry hooks in resolver/cache; sasha -> draft migration playbook + tenant notice templates. Revisit in next architecture sync. :+1:

deploy-bot: rwd-controlplane:deploy-schema-v2 scheduled to staging at 2026-03-25T22:00:00Z :rocket:
